transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

My mom made me come. I just... I can't really make myself do anything anymore. I mostly just sit in my room. I don't even change my clothes most days. I used to knit and journal, and I liked going for walks, but I don't do any of that now. When my mom asks me what's wrong, I just... I barely even have the energy to give her an answer.
Do you ever hear voices when no one is there?
No, I don't. I mean... no. It's just quiet. I don't hear anything like that.
I don't think so. I mean, I don't feel sad, really. I don't feel much of anything. It's just... empty, I guess. I'm just tired all the time. But I wouldn't call it depressed.
Do you feel like anyone is trying to harm you or control you?

Yeah... I do. Since I was in those college classes, I've just... I've known that the school portal and the clinic practicum people are doing things. They use these little wording changes in their emails, and in the comments on my assignments. It's to mark me as someone they don't want in healthcare. My mom says they're just regular messages, but... I know what they're actually doing.
Have you ever had a period when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

No, I haven't. I mean... I don't think so. Like I said, I don't really feel sad like that. I just feel kind of empty and tired. But I haven't ever had a time where I felt depressed all day for weeks. It's not really like that.
Have you ever had a time when you felt unusually high, euphoric, or extremely irritable for several days in a row?
No, I haven't ever felt like that. I don't really get... high or euphoric. And I'm not really irritable for days on end either. I just... I mostly just feel like I do now. Tired and kind of blank.
Have there ever been times when those beliefs about the school or clinic happened only while you were feeling depressed or unusually energized?

No... it's not like that. Like I was saying, I don't really get depressed or unusually energized anyway. The things with the school portal and the clinic... that just happens all the time. It doesn't have anything to do with how I'm feeling. It's just what they're doing.
